contract.opt_in: activate_relation_assessment_v2; revision-1 tasks keep their pins and two requests

repair_frame.edit_rules: proposals unchanged except drops of listed proposals; dispositions already given unchanged; new dispositions only for listed pairs, related where an unchanged proposal relates the pair or not_assessed with a reason; anything else settles invalid_output
repair_frame.instruction: Your previous result would be refused for the reasons listed. Return it again with only these changes: give each listed pair a disposition and drop each listed proposal. A new disposition is related only where one of your unchanged proposals relates that pair; otherwise it is not_assessed, with a reason. No evidence is sent again; change nothing else.
repair_frame.records: no relation delivery, exposure or attestation; intent and usage as for any request
repair_frame.relation_packet: the author packet this attempt already delivered, without its evidence

contract.request_headroom: request_limit 3: the author, at most one author repair frame and the batched specialist; the per-attempt dollar ceiling is unchanged

PairDisposition.description:
The author's disposition of one unordered pair of pinned beads.

`not_assessed` stays valid and is never unrelated. A pair's disposition does
not show that every statement pair in it was considered.
PairDisposition.title: PairDisposition

RelationAssessmentOutput.description:
The applied result: the author's output and every specialist contribution.

Batching is a profile choice: every proposal is judged exactly once across
the contributions, and there is no contribution without a proposal.
RelationAssessmentOutput.title: RelationAssessmentOutput

RelationEndpoint.description: An accepted pinned bead version and one to eight of its statements.
RelationEndpoint.title: RelationEndpoint

RelationEvidencePin.description: One exact statement-evidence pair of an endpoint or basis statement.
RelationEvidencePin.title: RelationEvidencePin

RelationJudgment.description:
The specialist's assessment of one exact proposed assertion.

`consistent` covers the whole assertion: endpoints, basis statements,
attribution, qualification, rationale, predicate, revision and direction.
`warranted` lists every predicate, revision and direction the specialist
finds warranted over the same endpoints, possibly none.
RelationJudgment.title: RelationJudgment

RelationProposal.description:
One exact proposed assertion: "source <forward reading> target".

Neither endpoint has to be the subject bead, and both may sit in one bead
when their statements differ. Basis statements, separate from both
endpoints, state or support the relationship and carry its attribution; a
source-stated assertion names at least one.
RelationProposal.title: RelationProposal

RelationSpecialistDecision.description: One specialist batch: a judgment for every proposal it was given.

RelationTypeDefinition.description:
An exact active vocabulary revision pinned at activation.

Built-in revision 1 is the owner-approved relation semantic profile. The
endpoint rule names what the source and target statements describe; an
inverse reading is the same assertion, never a second one. Self-reference is
always refused, and a `forbidden` cycle policy also refuses cycles between
statements among the key's active assertions.
RelationTypeDefinition.title: RelationTypeDefinition
